_comment: Contexts must match CI job names byte-for-byte. The matrix job is named
'Python (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.python-version }})', so each of the
twelve legs is its own context -- an earlier version of this file listed
'Python (ubuntu-latest)' without the Python version, which can never match
any reported check and would leave every pull request waiting forever.
The CodeQL upload reports as 'CodeQL', not 'Code scanning results / CodeQL'.
The live setting still requires the latter, which is why PRs on this repo
currently cannot merge; applying this file corrects that.
